name: Globalstar, Inc.
summary: Globalstar, Inc. provides mobile satellite services in the United States, Canada, Europe, Central and South America, and internationally. It offers duplex two-way voice and data products, including mobile voice and data services and equipment for remote business continuity, recreational usage, safety, emergency preparedness and response, and other applications.
